player_0.content: New plan: I incorrectly identified "Eager" as the dominant emotion because Dr. Rigby was offering hope, but I failed to recognize the underlying tension and rejection from Ellie ("You're nuts," "shitty decisions"). This rejection likely triggered defensiveness or frustration in Dr. Rigby, not just eagerness. I should have analyzed Ellie's hostile pushback as a direct threat to his argument, which would elevate "Defensive" significantly. Next time, I will prioritize "Defensive" as the primary emotion when a character faces direct insults or dismissal of their core message, while keeping "Eager" lower to reflect the struggle against resistance. I will also ensure I do not assign a score of 0 to "Defensive" if the character is being challenged.
